classification: HYPOTHETICAL ILLUSTRATION, not an observed scheme or market forecast
convention: Within each month, all costs paid before that month sales receipts. Peak is measured at this pre-receipt point, not only month end.
programme: Phased sales assume the relevant homes can be completed and sold on the illustrative dates. No construction-feasibility model.
cash_use: Sales receipts treated as available to meet project costs; no lender redemption waterfall, release conditions, retentions or restrictions.
excluded: Changes in prices, costs or build programme between scenarios
month_basis: Relative project months 0 to 14, not calendar quarters
price_source: Chosen illustration, not derived from the Q3 median or an actual development valuation
